verdict.rationale: Preventing AI-model training on user data is a fair privacy question for any product that handles sensitive data, so the axis applies. The evidence shows local-first storage, end-to-end encryption, anonymous use and no telemetry, but no 2FAS statement, policy or control about AI training. Those privacy features are adjacent and do not show the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
